summary: A capped list offers to show all of it, and asks the host to open the whole list rather than following a link of its own.

then.note: The query travels with it, so the full view opens on the records the person was looking at rather than on an unfiltered collection. The component builds no address: an embedded list has nothing to build one from, and a guessed route would send a person to a page the product may not have.
